input.brief: Velora personal finance and wealth tracking platform

direction.name: The quiet instrument
direction.idea: Radical understatement. Where every competitor shouts, this page almost whispers: a headline barely larger than body text, a narrow column, small exact demonstrations, and a great deal of untouched space. The restraint is the claim. It says the thing is simple, finished and sure of itself. This only works when it is carried through completely; one loud element breaks it. In the study, a tool for simple lists sold itself with a 27px headline and 12–14px copy and was one of the most confident pages in the set.
direction.composition: A single column 440–560px wide, placed left of centre (starting at about 22% of the viewport width) or dead centre, running the whole page. The headline is the one large thing on the first screen: two lines at display size (5–7vw), medium weight, starting on the column's left edge and allowed to run wider than the column. The supporting paragraph follows at body size (17–19px) in the full ink. One small primary button and one text link. Below, each point is a short paragraph followed by a compact demonstration or image no wider than the column. Sections are separated only by space (96–140px). Nothing spans the full width until the footer, which is a single quiet line. The first screen is mostly empty and that emptiness is composed: the column's top edge sits at about 30% of the viewport height.
direction.typography: One family, two weights. A display size for the headline (5–7vw), one heading size for section titles (about 32–40px), body at 17–19px, a small size for captions (14–15px). Leading 1.5 for text. Letter-spacing near zero. The typeface must be handsome at small sizes.
direction.colour: Paper and two inks (full and soft). One accent used on exactly one element per screen.
direction.imagery: Precise rather than loud: cropped interface details at true size, and real photographs of the customer's world held to the column width, each doing one job. One short looping clip can sit at column width too. Never a large stock hero image.
direction.richness: Precision. With so little on the page, alignment, spacing and the exact size relationships are the design. Every element shares the column's left edge.
direction.pitfalls: This is the one direction where a small headline is right; the inspector will not object, but do not mix it with a large display line. Emptiness must look decided: keep the column edges exact and the vertical rhythm even. Not suitable when the subject needs emotion or photography to sell. Quiet is not thin: the column must still deliver every piece of content the brief asks for, in full, at 16px or more in the full ink. In blind tests the quiet version lost every time it was quiet everywhere: a small headline beside an empty panel read as unfinished. Quiet means few things, not small things: the headline and the demonstration are large, and every screen holds content.

hero.name: Control that reads the page
hero.blueprint: A near-black or deep neutral ground split into two halves by tone alone: the right half is one step lighter than the left, and they meet at a clean vertical edge at 50%. Left half: a small logo mark top-left at a 40px margin, then two-thirds of empty ground, then everything else anchored bottom-left, 40px from the edges: a one-line headline at clamp(26px, 2.1vw, 32px) in medium weight, one supporting sentence at 17px in the softer ink held to 44ch, and the single action as a light rectangular button. Right half: one fragment of the product, centred, about 450px square, built in HTML and working. It is the product's defining control (a loupe, a picker, a dial, a field) and it acts on the page itself: it reads the real background colour, the real headline size or the pointer position and prints that value in its own readout at 13px. Mark its root with data-ui so the product's own radii and borders apply inside it. There is no navigation bar; one text link sits top-right at 15px.
hero.mobile: The halves stack as two tones. The fragment comes first: 78vw square, centred in the lighter block, which is 58svh tall, still live and reading the page under the visitor's finger. The darker block below holds the headline at 6.4vw on up to two lines, the sentence at 16px and the button, left-aligned at 20px. The logo mark sits top-left over the first block.
hero.headline: One plain line at 26–32px naming what the tool is, up to about 32 characters, wrapping to two lines on a phone.

type.note: A sturdy screen-reading serif with a large x-height; headings are simply the text face at medium weight and a larger size. Suits essays, reports, newsletters and knowledge products.

palette.name: Black and crimson
palette.note: Black with off-white text and mid-grey texture takes nearly the whole page, and the last sections may invert to off-white with black type. Deep crimson is scattered sparingly: a few characters in a heading, a slider fill, the one button.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: One row, three states
sections.blueprint: The product's central row (a task, a transaction, a message, a deploy) is shown three times, one directly beneath the other, in three states: as it arrives, with the pointer on it and its actions revealed, and finished. Each copy is built at true size, 640px wide, with real names, amounts and times, its root marked data-ui; inside it the product's own control borders and radii apply. The copies sit in columns 4–9 with 56px between them and nothing framing them. In columns 1–3, right-aligned and level with each copy, one word at 22px in the soft ink names its state. Columns 10–12 stay empty. The middle copy is live: its checkbox or button works and turns it into the third state. The heading, two to four words at 28–32px, sits on column 4's left edge, 96px above the first copy, with no supporting line.
sections.mobile: Copies stack at full width with 16px margins and stay at true size; a row wider than the screen is cropped at its right end, never shrunk. Each state word sits beneath its copy at 17px in the soft ink, 10px away. 48px separates the three groups. Heading at 26px.

sections.name: Fixed output, live controls
sections.blueprint: A split the reader operates. Left, columns 1–6: a flat colour field that is position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh, edge to edge, holding one thing the product makes (a card, an email, a chart, a rendered page) centred at true size, about 420px wide, root marked data-ui. Right, columns 8–12: a reading column no wider than 44ch, with four or five capability blocks 50vh apart. Each block is a sentence at 28–32px, a paragraph at 17px, and directly beneath it one real control at interface size: a slider, a segmented choice, a toggle, a short text field. Operating a control changes the fixed output on the left at once, and changes persist, so by the last block the reader has configured their own. The section heading, two to four words at 40–44px, opens the right column, 72px from the top.
sections.mobile: The output sits in a sticky field at the top, 42svh tall, cropped to its most telling region, not shrunk. Blocks scroll beneath on the page ground: sentence at 22px, paragraph at 16px, control at full width with 44px targets. The field releases after the last block.

sections.name: Quiet figure lines
sections.blueprint: Numbers stated without raising the voice. In columns 2–7, a definition-list layout: three to five rows, each a two-track grid. The first track is 132px wide and holds the figure, right-aligned, at 28–32px in medium weight and full ink with tabular numerals. The second track, after a 24px gap, holds one sentence at 16–17px in the soft ink, at most 40ch, whose first baseline matches the figure's baseline. Sentences share one left edge and figures one right edge, so a clean channel of space runs down between them. 28px between rows. The heading, two to four words at 24–28px, sits 56px above on the sentences' left edge, not the figures'. Optionally, a single small square photograph occupies columns 9–11, its top 80px lower than the first row, with no caption. Leave at least 18vh of empty ground above and below the block.
sections.mobile: The grid stays two-track, with the figure track narrowed to 88px and figures at 24px; sentences at 16px wrap beside them. If the photograph is used it comes after the rows at 56% width, flush right. The heading is 22px on the sentences' left edge.

sections.name: One long letter
sections.blueprint: A single testimonial given room to be read, set like a letter. One column 34–38ch wide begins at column 5 of 12, or shares the page's own reading column. The first sentence of the quotation is pulled up as the opening line at 28–32px in medium weight, two lines at most. The rest follows as two or three ordinary paragraphs at 18–19px with leading 1.55 and 20px between paragraphs, in the full ink, not grey. It closes the way a letter does: 40px of space, then the name on one line and the role on the next at 16px. In columns 1–3, top-aligned with the first line, sits either nothing or one small square photograph of the writer, 120px wide. There are no quotation marks at all; the letter form makes them unnecessary. Space above and below is 140px.
sections.mobile: The column takes the full width with 20px margins. If there is a photograph it goes first at 96px square, left-aligned. Opening sentence at 24px, body at 17px, sign-off beneath. Nothing else changes; this section is already a phone composition.

sections.name: Question index, one answer
sections.blueprint: Questions on the left, one answer on the right, and the answer changes as the reader moves through the questions. Columns 1–5 list all questions at one size, 18px, with 18px between them; each is preceded by a solid dot 8px across, in the softer ink when idle and in the accent colour when selected. The selected question is in the full ink, the rest in the softer ink. Columns 7–12 hold the answer pane, `position: sticky; top: 120px`: the selected answer at 24–28px in the regular weight, leading 1.3, measure about 30ch, so the answer, not the question, is the large type. Selection follows hover, click and keyboard focus; the pane crossfades in 150ms. The first question is selected on load. A two-word heading in the softer ink is the first line of the list, at the same 18px.
sections.mobile: The list runs full width at 18px. Tapping a question colours its dot and opens its answer directly beneath at 19px, indented to line up with the question text; other answers close. There is no pane and no sticky element.

sections.name: A plain sentence, one action
sections.blueprint: The page ends on an almost empty screen. On the page ground, with no band and no panel, one sentence of eight to fourteen words is set at 18–22px in the regular weight, in the full ink, no wider than 34ch, on the same left edge as the page's text column (or centred only if the whole page is centred). 24px beneath it sits one small filled button, about 40px tall with 18px side padding, and optionally one text link beside it on the same baseline. That is all. Above the sentence leave at least 30svh of empty ground and below it at least 20svh before the footer line, so the emptiness reads as decided. The sentence is written as something a person would say, and it names the action plainly. No headline-sized type appears anywhere in this section.
sections.mobile: Identical in spirit: the sentence at 18px with 20px margins, the button beneath at its natural width (not full width), 44px tall. Keep 20svh of empty ground above the sentence and 14svh below the button, before the footer line.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: Cursor Compile
references.idea: The event name drawn as seven looping one-line curves in seven colours, more signature than logotype, on an otherwise whisper-quiet off-white page whose images are re-rendered as rows of coloured characters.
references.hero: Warm off-white field with no header or navigation. Starting about 23% down, a line-drawn wordmark spans from 8% to 92% of the width and about 29% of the height: each letter is a single 2px stroke looping like a Lissajous figure, each in a different colour (orange, green, olive, lilac, black, brown, blue), overlapping its neighbours. Directly beneath, two 14px captions, one flush left in ink and one flush right in grey. After a gap of about 20% of the viewport, three equal columns sit at the bottom, each topped by a hairline: an 18px statement, a grey 14px paragraph, and an email field over a full-width near-black rectangular button.
references.type: The only large lettering is the drawn wordmark. All real text is CursorGothic regular in two sizes, 18px and 14px (the largest text on the page is 1.8vw), sentence case, with hierarchy made by ink versus mid-grey rather than by size or weight.
references.colour: #edece8 #26251e #f07a1f #2e9e3a #2f6bf0 #9b8ff0 — Warm paper ground with near-black and grey text. The wordmark's colours return one at a time as the single ink of each character-rendered image (lilac, teal, green, orange). Event photos are dark and warm.
references.imagery: Two kinds: landmarks and speaker portraits redrawn as rows of tiny characters in one saturated colour on a tint of the same colour; and dark, warm documentary event photos. All are square-cornered rectangles in strict rows.
references.layout: About 7% side margins on a three-column grid. Each section has a small two-line heading at left (title in ink, subtitle in grey), then a row or carousel of equal tiles with one-line captions beneath. Very large vertical gaps between sections; a denser photo grid near the end.

sections.description: Tour dates as a three-column grid of 3:2 tiles. Each tile is a city landmark rendered entirely in rows of small characters in one colour on a pale tint of that colour: lilac, teal, green, orange. Under each tile, one caption line: city name in ink, date in grey straight after it, and a status word flush right. A fourth tile wraps alone to the left of a second row, leaving two columns empty.

Session recordings as stacked carousels. A small heading and grey subtitle, then per stage a tiny label at left with two arrow glyphs at far right and a row of 16:9 dark photo tiles, two full tiles visible and a third cropped by the margin. Each tile has a small white event tag in its bottom-left corner. Caption beneath: speaker name in ink followed by the talk title in grey on the same line.

Speaker row: one-line heading at left, arrows at right, then four near-square portrait tiles with 8px gaps, each a face drawn in horizontal rows of characters in one colour on its tint (orange, green, lilac, teal). Some tiles show only plain stripes with the face barely emerging, so portraits appear to resolve from lines as they load or on hover.

After a three-column photo grid with mixed landscape and portrait crops and 8px gaps, the page ends on an empty off-white screen holding one centred sentence at 18px and a small dark pill button beneath it. There are no footer columns, links or legal rows.

steal: Draw the name as one continuous thin looping stroke per letter, each in a different colour, and let it be the only large element on the page.
Keep all text at two small sizes and build hierarchy from ink versus grey on the same line (name in ink, detail in grey right after it).
Re-render photographs as rows of tiny characters in a single saturated colour on a tint of that colour, one colour per tile.

references.name: Rows
references.idea: Radical understatement: a product about simple lists is sold with a 27px headline, 12px copy and a column of small live demos, each proving one interaction.
references.hero: Warm off-white page, almost empty. Everything hangs on one vertical line 27% in from the left. A small striped-letter logo mark sits there near the top; 220px lower comes a two-line headline at only 27px (under 2vw), then three lines of 13px body about 370px wide, then a near-black rectangular button with 4px corners beside a text link with an arrow. A single grey sign-in link sits in the top-right corner; there is no navigation bar. More than 80% of the viewport is blank. At the bottom edge the first feature module peeks in: grey demo panel left, short text column right.
references.type: Suisse Intl only, weight 450–500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 27px, feature headings about 16px on two lines, body 12px. Three sizes in total, no uppercase and no display moment; hierarchy comes from weight and empty space alone.
references.colour: #f5f6f1 #e6e7e1 #1a191d #ffffff #c7372f #3aa56a — Warm paper off-white with slightly darker grey-green demo panels and near-black type; colour appears only inside the UI as priority dots, outlined status pills and one green or red action button.
references.imagery: No pictures: small live-rendered fragments of the app (two or three white list rows with dots, status pills, avatars and a visible cursor) sit in flat grey panels of fixed 368px width with barely rounded corners.
references.layout: One content block about 650px wide, offset left of centre, repeated down the page: 368px demo panel plus a 245px text column, top-aligned, separated by 200px or more of empty space. The logo mark sticks to the top-left corner on scroll. Footer is one line.

sections.description: The repeating module: a flat grey panel roughly 368px wide and 120–190px tall holding a tiny mock list (white rows with 6px radius, a coloured numbered dot at left, task title, an outlined status pill, an avatar, a chevron) and often a cursor mid-action. To its right, 20px away and top-aligned, a medium-weight heading of one or two lines and two short paragraphs at 11–12px in a column only 245px wide. Modules never alternate sides; they stack with large gaps.

The closing block keeps the same narrow measure: a three-line paragraph at 13px, then the identical button and arrow-link pair from the hero, left-aligned on the text column's axis. After a long gap a single hairline spans the 650px block and under it sits one row of tiny footer text: brand line at left, six links and a copyright strung along the right.

steal: Set the headline at near-body size (under 2vw) and let empty space, not scale, give it importance.
Explain each feature with a tiny cropped fragment of real UI in a fixed-width flat panel, one interaction per panel, with the cursor left visible.
Hang the whole page on one off-centre left edge and never break it, logo and footer included.

references.name: Moto Finance
references.idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
references.hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
references.type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
references.colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
references.imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
references.layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.
